routes.routeName: Yampa River Hayden Pump Station to Yampa River State Park Headquarters

gauge.relationship: direct same-river telemetry near the downstream end of the Hayden reach
gauge.threshold: CPW seasonal flow ranges and class guidance only; no station-certified recreational threshold

takeOut.name: Yampa River State Park Headquarters boat ramp

camping.rule: Headquarters campground is a separate reservation-based basecamp; overnight camping is not allowed at the pump station and no on-route camping is claimed.

imagery.captionPosture: Headquarters boat-ramp same-river context, not pump-station conditions.

routes.deduplication: Distinct 13-mile CPW Site 1-to-Site 2 section ending at Headquarters; adjacent to, but not overlapping, Headquarters-to-Dorsey.

routes.routeName: Yampa River State Park Headquarters to State Wildlife Area (Dorsey)

gauge.relationship: direct same-river telemetry at the downstream Dorsey reach
gauge.threshold: CPW seasonal flow ranges and class guidance only; no station-certified recreational threshold

putIn.name: Yampa River State Park Headquarters boat ramp

camping.rule: Headquarters campground is a separate reservation-based basecamp; no Dorsey overnight camping is claimed for this route.

imagery.captionPosture: Headquarters boat-ramp same-river context, not Dorsey conditions.

routes.deduplication: Distinct 7-mile CPW Site 2-to-Site 3 section; shared Headquarters access is the official CPW boundary and is not a duplicate route.

routes.routeName: Yampa River Yampa Valley Golf Course to Loudy Simpson Park

gauge.relationship: direct same-river telemetry near the downstream Craig reach
gauge.threshold: CPW seasonal flow ranges and class guidance only; no station-certified recreational threshold

putIn.name: Yampa Valley Golf Course boat ramp

camping.rule: Loudy Simpson camping requires county permission; no Golf Course overnight camping claim.

imagery.captionPosture: Yampa State Park boat-ramp same-river context, not Craig endpoint conditions.

routes.deduplication: Distinct 3.5-mile CPW Site 4-to-Site 5 section; separate from Headquarters-to-Dorsey and Loudy Simpson-to-South Beach.

routes.routeName: Yampa River Loudy Simpson Park to South Beach / Yampa Project Pump Station

gauge.relationship: direct same-river telemetry adjacent to the South Beach reach
gauge.threshold: CPW seasonal flow ranges and class guidance only; no station-certified recreational threshold

takeOut.name: South Beach / Yampa Project Pump Station boat ramp

camping.rule: Loudy Simpson requires county permission; South Beach primitive camping requires a current permit and posted stay limit.

imagery.captionPosture: Yampa State Park boat-ramp same-river context, not Craig endpoint conditions.

routes.deduplication: Distinct 5.5-mile CPW Site 5-to-Site 6 section; separate from Golf Course-to-Loudy Simpson and downstream Little Yampa Canyon.

routes.routeName: Yampa River Duffy Mountain to Juniper Canyon

gauge.relationship: direct same-river telemetry near the downstream Maybell reach
gauge.threshold: CPW seasonal flow ranges and class guidance only; no station-certified recreational threshold

camping.rule: Duffy has one primitive site and Juniper has five; park and camping passes are required and sites are designated only.

imagery.captionPosture: Yampa State Park boat-ramp same-river context, not Duffy or Juniper current conditions.

routes.deduplication: Distinct 12-mile CPW Site 7-to-Site 8 section; separate from South Beach-to-Duffy and Juniper-to-Maybell.

routes.routeName: Yampa River Juniper Canyon to Maybell Bridge

gauge.relationship: direct same-river telemetry near the downstream Maybell endpoint
gauge.threshold: CPW seasonal flow ranges and class guidance only; no station-certified recreational threshold

camping.rule: Juniper has five primitive sites and Maybell has six; park and camping passes are required and sites are designated only.

imagery.captionPosture: Yampa State Park boat-ramp same-river context, not Juniper or Maybell current conditions.

routes.deduplication: Distinct 13-mile CPW Site 8-to-Site 9 section; separate from Duffy-to-Juniper and Maybell-to-Sunbeam.
